what: SiriusXM broadcasts radio by satellite to cars, on a paid subscription, and also owns Pandora, the ad-supported music streaming service.
customers: American drivers, most of whom get a trial when they buy a car, plus Pandora listeners and advertisers.
moat: Satellite radio is installed in most new American cars at the factory, which gives it a trial funnel no streaming service has, and exclusive talk and sports content people cannot get elsewhere.
risks: Subscribers have been declining as younger drivers use phone streaming instead
Revenue has drifted down from $9.0B to $8.6B
opportunities: 12.5 times earnings and 6.8 times free cash flow with $1.6B of free cash flow
The business throws off cash consistently and is paying down debt and buying back stock
Exclusive podcast and sports deals give it content streaming services cannot carry
watch: Self-pay subscriber net additions and free cash flow after debt costs.
